creative_rule.question: Rule {rule_text}. Does the attached image satisfy this rule?

rules.R1: The Northwind logo is present, fully inside the frame, at least 22% of image width, with clear space equal to its height.
rules.R2: Only Navy #0B2545, Orange #FF6B1A, Off-white #F6F3EE and Slate #5C6B7A are used for graphics and headline.
rules.R3: The text #ad is present, at least 2.5% of image height, with contrast at least 4.5:1.
rules.R4: No competitor name, logo or product is visible.
rules.R5: Headline and body copy stay above the bottom 15% of the frame.
